name: vision_pose_bad
title: The same pose trainer with eight planted defects
origin: domain-vision round 2: the dirty twin of vision_pose. Its MLV205 label is the one that shows a workspace nn.Module loss class silencing the rule with no coverage diagnostic (VIS2-09)

expected.why: every BatchNorm2d in the stem, the two branches and the fuse layer updates its running statistics from the validation split - twice per image, because the flip test runs a second forward

expected.defect: MultiStepLR is stepped once per batch instead of once per epoch
expected.why: the milestones at 170 and 200 are passed inside the first epoch, so the whole 210-epoch run trains at 1/100 of the intended learning rate

expected.symbol: for images, targets, weights, _meta in loader
expected.why: two full graphs per batch - the forward and the flip-test forward - are built and dropped

expected.defect: the training loader does not shuffle
expected.why: COCO person crops are written image by image, so consecutive batches are the same scene at the same scale
expected.note: found at confidence 0.54 / possible, below mlview.minConfidence 0.6, so it does not reach the Problems panel: the dataset is a workspace Dataset subclass so the TRAIN_SPLIT tag is absent and only the name regex applies

expected.defect: the running loss keeps the live tensor
expected.why: an HRNet heatmap graph over 17 joint planes is retained for the whole epoch
expected.gap: the criterion is a workspace nn.Module (JointsMSELoss), so the value it returns never acquires the LOSS tag and MLV205's operand test fails. No untagged_dataflow diagnostic is emitted either, so the silence is not declared. One-line repro in the round-2 report (VIS2-09).

expected.defect: the validation dataset is constructed with train=True, so the random scale, rotation and flip are applied to the split the PCK is reported on
expected.why: the reported PCK is measured on randomly rotated and rescaled crops and moves by several points between runs for that reason alone
expected.gap: MLV114 matches a Compose containing a random-augmentation FQN. This project's augmentation is numpy and cv2 behind a boolean flag, which is how every mmpose-style dataset is written, and no rule models a train/eval flag on a Dataset constructor.

expected.defect: the whole module is pickled rather than its state_dict
expected.why: the checkpoint carries the class path and stops loading the day model.py moves

expected.defect: the horizontal flip mirrors the coordinates but never swaps the left/right joint channels
expected.why: after every flip the plane that should predict the left wrist is trained on the right wrist, so half the signal for eight of seventeen joints is inverted - the model still converges, to a systematically worse answer
expected.gap: no rule models a label-space transform that has to accompany a geometric one. This is the single most common pose-estimation bug and it is invisible to every rule in the catalog.

expected.defect: the flip test averages the mirrored heatmaps without swapping the left/right channels back
expected.why: each paired joint is averaged with its opposite, so every predicted keypoint is pulled toward the body midline and the reported PCK understates the model
expected.gap: same gap as above: the flip_back channel permutation is a label-space operation no rule knows about.

forbidden.why: there is no sklearn transformer in this project
the validation loader is still built with shuffle=False
the loaders are built inside build_loaders(), reached only from main() under the __main__ guard
optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True) is still the first statement of the training step
optimizer.step() is still called every batch
there is no no_grad region left in this file, so nothing can be inside one
THE TRAP: JointsMSELoss.forward still accumulates `total = total + ...` across 17 joints and RETURNS it - the caller owns the graph, which is the documented vision-05 guard
there is no gradient clipping in this project
the PCK is still computed on argmax-decoded coordinates
there is no softmax and no CrossEntropyLoss in this project
the head is a bare 1x1 Conv2d and the objective is MSE; there is no BCE anywhere
the model and the criterion are moved with .to(device) and every batch tensor is moved inside both loops
seed_everything() still seeds random, numpy, torch and torch.cuda
there is no split in this project
every nn.Module subclass calls super().__init__() first
the branches are wrapped in nn.ModuleList

gaps.what: no rule models a label-space transform that must accompany a geometric augmentation (left/right joint swap on flip, box coordinate flip, segmentation-mask flip)
gaps.evidence: dataset.py:80 and train.py:133 against the clean twin's flip_joints and flip_back

gaps.what: no rule models a Dataset whose augmentation is switched by a train=True/False constructor flag, which is how mmpose, mmdet and mmseg datasets are written
gaps.evidence: train.py:75 against the clean twin's train=False
